title: Soatok's Informal Guide to Threat Models
summary: Soatok, a well-known security researcher from Dhole Labs, provides an informal yet practical guide to threat modeling, offering insights on systematic approaches to identifying and mitigating security risks in software systems.
problem_solved: Helps developers and security professionals systematically identify, quantify, and prioritize security threats before they can be exploited.
why_valuable: Threat modeling is a fundamental security practice that prevents costly security breaches by proactively identifying vulnerabilities during the design phase rather than after deployment.
